title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Issued a Minor Update iOS 11.3.1
text:
April 25, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Issued a Minor Update iOS 11.3.1 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) released iOS 11.3.1 for the mobile devices, and a security update to the already-released macOS 10.13.4 for Macs, a small software updates for iPhones, iPads, and Macs. 
iOS 11.3.1 is a minor update, at just over 49 megabytes, that fixes iPhone 8s for users whose touchscreens were rendered unresponsive, by aftermarket replacement displays.The iOS 11.3 caused Apple’s iPhones that had been serviced by outside vendors to have this issue. 
The users expressed their frustration that it seemed Apple Inc. was punishing them, for not going through the company’s own process for repairs.
